hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook that integrates Uniswap v4 pools with Euler lending vaults. It replaces standard concentrated liquidity with a proprietary bonding curve, executing swaps fully in `beforeSwap` by depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, using a delegatecall proxy architecture for per-pool instances.
